net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util

Class DataObjectBinding<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util.DataObjectBinding<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the type to bind ResultSet data to
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    MapDataObjectBinding, NoDataObjectBinding, NonUpdateCapableDataObjectBinding

    public abstract class DataObjectBinding<T>
extends Object
    Represents the binding of a single row in a ResultSet to an object. This class may be implemented by hand to allow for faster binding between ResultSet's and DataObjects. Default implementation exist for objects conforming to the EoD SQL "data-object" structure, and for any object that has a registered TypeMapper.
    Author:
    Jason Morris

      • getObjectType

        public Class<T> getObjectType()
        By default, this method will reflect on the current class and try to figure out it's type passed on the generic T declaration. If T is a wildcard with an upper-boundry, or a simple Class this method will return a valid Class object. Otherwise this method will throw an IllegalArgumentException.
        Returns:
        the Class type that will be returned by this DataObjectBinding

      • setObjectType

        protected void setObjectType(Class<T> objectType)
        Sets the type of object this DataObjectBinding will return from it's unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet) methods. This method should be invoked in the constructor of the DataObjectBinding so that getObjectType() will return the expected value.
        Parameters:

      • unmarshall

        public T unmarshall(ResultSet row)
             throws SQLException,
                    EoDException
        Map the current row in the specified ResultSet to an object. This method will call the implementations of unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet, java.lang.Object) and newInstance() to create the data-object and unmarshall the row data into it.
        Parameters:
        row - the ResultSet containing the data
        Returns:
        a new object containing the data that was found in the ResultSet
        Throws:
        SQLException - if a database error occured
        EoDException - if a mapping error occured
        See Also:
        unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet, java.lang.Object)

      • isRubberstampCapable

        public boolean isRubberstampCapable()
        Returned whether or not this DataObjectBinding can be used for rubberstamping. The general contract is that if the returned data-object is entirely mutable, then it is capable of rubberstamping. If the data-object is immutable, rubberstamping cannot be done (since a new object needs to be constructed for each row).
        Returns:
        true by default.

      • isUpdateCapable

        public boolean isUpdateCapable()

        Test to see if this DataObjectBinding object is capable of pushing an object into a ResultSet with the marshall(java.lang.Object, java.sql.ResultSet) method. If this method returns false then it can be assumed that any call to marshal will result in an UnsupportedOperationException.

        By default this method returns true, and so should be overridden by implementors that cannot update a ResultSet.

        Returns:
        true if invoking the marshal will not result in an UnsupportedOperationException

      • newInstance

        public T newInstance()
              throws EoDException

        Create a new, empty instance of the data-object this object will bind to. This method may return null if the data-object is an immutable primitive type.

        By default this method delegates to the Class.newInstance() method of this DataObjectBinding's object-type. Any reflection exceptions are wrapped in an EoDException and rethrown with a suitable error message.

        Returns:
        a new instance of the data-object
        Throws:
        EoDException - if the data-obejct could not be created

      • unmarshall

        public abstract void unmarshall(ResultSet row,
                                T into)
                         throws SQLException,
                                EoDException

        Unmarshall a ResultSet into a specified object. This method is used for any rubberstamping wrapper object. If the wrapper object is not rubberstamping, this method will not be invoked. Non-rubberstamping wrappers should make use of the unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet) method instead of this one.

        This method should make no effort to navigate the given ResultSet. The cursor of the ResultSet will be at the row to be unmarshalled and will be nagivated by the wrapper object if needed.

        If rubberstamping is not supported by this DataObjectBinding, this method may throw an UnsupportedOperationException.

        Parameters:
        row - the ResultSet to unmarshall from
        into - the mutable object to unmarshall into
        Throws:
        SQLException - if a database error occures
        EoDException - if an unmarshalling error occures
        UnsupportedOperationException - if rubberstamping is not supported by this DataObjectBinding object

      • marshall

        public abstract void marshall(T from,
                              ResultSet results)
                       throws SQLException,
                              EoDException
        Marshall a specified object into a ResultSet. This method should only be used if a call to isUpdateCapable() returns true. This method will attempt to place the fields of the given object into the specified ResultSet. The ResultSet given here should be in the same format as the one given to unmarshall(java.sql.ResultSet), failure to do so can result in an EoDException.
        Parameters:
        from - the object to marshall
        results - the ResultSet who's columns are to be set
        Throws:
        SQLException - if an database error occures
        EoDException - if a marshalling error occures

        Try to create a DataObjectBinding for the specified dataObject class. This method will look at any known DataObjectBinding's, and if none can be found, it will fall back on the default DataObjectBinding.

      • setDefaultDataObjectBinding

        public static void setDefaultDataObjectBinding(Class<? extends DataObjectBinding> defaultBinding)
                                        throws IllegalArgumentException

        Set the Default-DataObjectBinding type. The type specified here must have a constructor with exactly the following signature (other than the DataObjectBinding class name): 

        public DataObjectBinding(Class<?>);

        If no DataObjectBinding has been set for a class that is requested through the getDataObjectBinding(java.lang.Class, net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util.DataObjectBinding.BindingType) method, an instance of the given type will be created passing the parameters of the getDataObjectBinding method into the constructor.

        Parameters:
        defaultBinding - the binding type to create for unknown DataObject types
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the DataObjectBinding doesn't have the required constructor
